question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd0c09452490048ac68f0a2e45ab07953eafc05496822bc9db7cf7c1c9dafaba.png] 

If a pie chart is drawn for the data related to the imports of the country over the 5 years, then what will be the central angle (in degrees) of the sector representing the imports in 2015 ?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The total number of imports of the country over the 5 years = (390 + 410 + 420 + 450 + 330)

⇒ 2000

The imports in 2015 = 410

The central angle of the sector representing the imports in 2015 = (410/2000 × 360°)

⇒ (0.205 × 360°)

⇒ 73.8° 

**∴ The required angle of imports in 2015 is 73.8° **
